name: Grommash's Folly raises Carve critical strikes by 5% per channel step while Inner Demon is active
contract: Grommash's Folly 805236: 'critical strikes with Carve deal $807427s1% increased damage, increasing up to 60% with each strike based on how long you channel.' 807427 Effect[0] is 5 per stack.
Owner ruling O-21/O-23 (Felsworn ADR 0011): +5% of the whole critical hit per Carve 800206 channel step, capped at 10 steps (+50%), only while Inner Demon 804216 is active; 60% stays unreachable.

One level 60 Felsworn with forced melee crits, attack power 20000 and one passive dummy in front. Each block channels Carve 8 times and sums the critical Carve strikes 803715 on the dummy. Control arms run before Grommash's Folly is learned, the talent arms after, with the same step count.
Expected talent/control damage: 1.50 at 10 steps and 1.05 at 1 step with Inner Demon, 1.00 at 10 steps without it (each within 0.01). The previous 3% factor gave 1.30, 1.03 and 1.30.
